rationale.verdict: Zero contract addresses were catalogued because (a) the protocol website is a JS SPA returning no content, (b) no GitHub repo is recorded, (c) no audit links are pinned, and (d) general web searches for 'stUSDT contract address' returned only generic USDT TRC-20 guidance rather than stUSDT-specific addresses. The Zendesk documentation describes the protocol architecture (stUSDT-RWA Contract, stUSDT token, wstUSDT wrapper, JustLend DAO custody) but contains no deployed addresses. Assessment cannot proceed beyond off-chain-only; grade is unknown pending a successful TronScan / Etherscan fetch of the stUSDT contract address.

protocol_metadata.about: stUSDT is a rebasing Real-World Asset (RWA) protocol deployed on the Tron and Ethereum blockchains. Users stake USDT into the stUSDT-RWA Contract and receive stUSDT receipt tokens that accrue yield through a daily rebase mechanism, maintaining a 1:1 exchange rate with USDT. The protocol is launched by RWA DAO and operated under custody by JustLend DAO, with an Advisory Council and RWA Arrangers overseeing investment strategy and performance disclosure. A wrapped, non-rebasing version called wstUSDT is also available for use in DeFi protocols.
